name: Rockport
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Rockport, MA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Rockport, MA: Santa by lobster boat, the Dock Square tree lighting, carriage rides on Bearskin Neck and library holiday parties.
lede: Rockport does Christmas on the harbor, with Santa arriving by lobster boat, a tree lighting in Dock Square, horse drawn carriages on Bearskin Neck and a torch lit pageant.
celebrates: Christmas in Rockport is organized around Dock Square and the harbor. Santa arrives by lobster boat at T-Wharf, local Cub and Brownie Scouts lead him to the First Baptist Church for photos, and the Dock Square tree is lit with carolers from the Dock Square Carolers and the Cape Ann Youth Chorus. Free carriage rides run along Bearskin Neck, Mistletoe Madness invites visitors to visit participating shops through December, and the Rockport Art Association stages a torch lit Christmas pageant. The library adds a gingerbread party and a pajama movie.
lastyear: A video posted from Saturday, December 6, 2025, shows Santa arriving by boat at T-Wharf at 1 pm, with the tree lighting at 4 pm that afternoon. The 2026 schedule on the Christmas in Rockport page keeps the same pattern, with Santa's arrival at 1 pm, photos at the First Baptist Church hall, the Dock Square Carolers and the closing song Christmas in Rockport as the square lights up.
facts: The Rockport Art Association says its Christmas pageant was started in 1947 by Dr. William F. Strangman and Mrs. Aldro Hibbard as a gift from the association to the village. It begins with a torch lit procession from Dock Square up Main Street to the Congregational Church, where the Nativity story is told in live narration. The Rockport Fire Department also gives Santa a ride on its ladder truck on Christmas Eve.
trains: Rockport is the end of the line for the MBTA Newburyport/Rockport Line, with trains from North Station through Salem, Beverly, Manchester and Gloucester to the Rockport station. That makes a car free trip to the harbor possible, and the line page lists stops and schedules. For a holiday train ride, Edaville in Carver runs trains through Christmas lights, and the Boston Street Railway Association shows historic streetcars.

kidfact: Rockport's Santa arrives by lobster boat, and Cub and Brownie Scouts help lead him to the church for photos.
faq: How does Santa arrive in Rockport?

Santa crosses Sandy Bay on a lobster boat and lands at T-Wharf on Rockport Harbor. A Rockport Forest Fire truck and local Cub and Brownie Scouts then lead Santa and Mrs. Claus along T-Wharf and Broadway to the First Baptist Church, where children can have photos taken with them in the church hall.
When is the Rockport tree lighting?

The tree lighting is held in Dock Square on the same day Santa arrives, according to the Christmas in Rockport schedule. Carolers start before the ceremony, and the program ends with a rendition of Christmas in Rockport as the square lights up. Check the Christmas in Rockport site for each year's exact times.
Are there horse drawn carriage rides in Rockport?

Yes. Christmas in Rockport runs free horse drawn carriage rides on Bearskin Neck on two December afternoons, with live music from groups such as the Jambalaya Horns and the Solstice Singers. The organizers list the rides as free and open to all, and they thank Tuck's Candy and Denim Blanket Co. as sponsors.
What is the Rockport Christmas pageant?

It is a torch lit live re-enactment of the Nativity presented by the Rockport Art Association and Museum. The pageant starts with a torch lit procession from Dock Square up Main Street to the Congregational Church, where the story is narrated live. The association says it began in 1947.
Can I take a train to Rockport at Christmas?

Yes. The MBTA Newburyport/Rockport Line ends at Rockport, with stops including Salem, Beverly, Manchester and Gloucester along the way. Edaville in Carver is a longer trip for a holiday train ride through Christmas lights, and the Boston Street Railway Association page covers historic streetcars.
